_doc: Group (b) of builds/wishlist.md: Modifiers on existing stats. Phase A proposals, unpriced; a later wiring pass applies them. Sizes: technique passives follow design/techniques/catalogue-*.json by tier (tier 0 about half a tree notable per line; tiers 1-3 about one notable per line); item lines follow design/items/catalogue-*.json by grade, and a replaced line keeps its W through the breadth multiplier (modifiers.md Formulas B-C). Where a wish quoted a tree number that differs, the wish's number is in the note. The depth proposal techniques (sects/*.techniques.json) have no passives field yet: an 'add' to 'passives' creates it, in the catalogue's {key, value, scope} form. Only gaps are wired: a line a requester's piece already carries is not added twice. Each wire carries 'value', the line or tag it adds or the replacement; a replace also carries 'old'.

For attack_pct, the Status Catalogue gives Bleed's ticks the tags bleed, over_time and physical, and hc-fume-censer's attack_pct [over_time] makes the same reading. The engine is to confirm that a tick matches its status tags.

entries.refused_part: The literal ask (stack_effect_pct and stack_duration_pct scoped [bleed]) breaks modifiers.md rule 8: those stats target element stacks only, and Bleed is a status, so the scope can never match and fails validation. The two lines above are the same idea on stats whose target is a status or a hit. More stacks (Bleed stacks to 5) would be the status stack cap, which is a Pending stat.

wire.note: ngu_tran_bac. The Pivot's Stone Warden Call summons a companion on its own timer: its record uses the summon op, its effects modify companion_speed, and Effects rule 16 R31 allows one companion per source. So the companion stats reach the wardens, and the flag's attack_pct 18 [companion] already scales their damage. The flag goes from about 30.5 W to 38.5 W of its 51.2 W grade-4 budget. The engine is to confirm that a summon's fixed coefficient also reads the power share; companion speed reaches it either way.

entries.refused_part: Two parts of the literal ask cannot be authored. companion_health_pct 15 does nothing while companions cannot be targeted (combat.md rule 19). A construct scope cannot be added either: companion_power_pct has target 'none', and no construct tag exists. Both lines are unscoped, so they also reach any beast he tames.
